bottleneck.description: US defence-technology firm spanning aerial target drones, tactical jet drones, solid rocket motors and hypersonics, C5ISR and satellite ground systems; near-sole supplier of high-performance aerial targets to the US Air Force.

dependency.key_customers: US Air Force, US Navy, US Department of Defense (MACH-TB hypersonic test bed)

editorial.notes: Kratos holds one genuine choke-point pocket: it is the dominant, effectively single-source supplier of US Air Force aerial target drones (BQM-167), where qualifying an alternative line would take years. That pocket alone would read HIGH. Against it, the rest of a diversified portfolio is contested; in solid rocket motors Kratos is the challenger trying to break the incumbent duopoly rather than the incumbent, and its Valkyrie tactical drone and ground-systems lines face active competition. Rated on the blended position the company lands MEDIUM, the treatment applied to other diversified niche-leaders, with the target-drone franchise noted as the sharp pocket. Heavy ITAR exposure runs across targets, hypersonics and motors.
